meta.name: tutor-setup
meta.description: Transforms knowledge sources into an Obsidian StudyVault. Two modes: (1) Document Mode — PDF/text/web sources → study notes with practice questions. (2) Codebase Mode — source code project → onboarding vault for new developers. Mode is auto-detected based on project markers in CWD.

copy.tagline: 将知识源转为结构化学习笔记与入职指南
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需将资料整理为带练习题的笔记或为新开发者准备代码库入门文档
copy.tagline_en: Transform knowledge sources into structured study notes and onboarding guides

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 将知识源（PDF、文本、网页、代码项目）自动转换为 Obsidian 学习库。文档模式生成带练习题的学习笔记；代码库模式为新开发者生成项目入门指南。
howto.when: 当你在当前工作目录下运行此技能时触发。它会自动检测目录中是否存在项目标记文件（如 package.json、pom.xml 等），从而决定使用文档模式或代码库模式。

say.text: 把当前文件夹里的 PDF 变成 Obsidian 学习笔记。
say.note: 触发文档模式，自动扫描并转换 PDF 文件。

say.text: 为这个代码项目生成新手入门学习库。
say.note: 触发代码库模式，分析项目结构并生成入门指南。

say.text: 把这篇网页文章做成带练习题的学习笔记。
say.note: 使用 WebFetch 获取网页内容，然后生成笔记。

howto.what_en: Transforms knowledge sources (PDF, text, web, code projects) into an Obsidian StudyVault. Document Mode creates study notes with practice questions; Codebase Mode generates an onboarding vault for new developers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you run this skill in the current working directory. It auto-detects project markers (e.g., package.json, pom.xml) to decide between Document Mode or Codebase Mode.

say_en.text: Turn PDFs in this folder into Obsidian study notes.
say_en.note: Triggers Document Mode, auto-scanning and converting PDFs.

say_en.text: Generate a new developer onboarding vault for this code project.
say_en.note: Triggers Codebase Mode, analyzing project structure and generating guides.

say_en.text: Turn this web article into study notes with practice questions.
say_en.note: Uses WebFetch to get the article content, then generates notes.
